recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-contrast portrait of a man in a weathered cowboy hat, leaning against a textured blue metallic surface. The composition features heavy, vertically condensed typography integrated into the lower-left quadrant, utilizing a cool-toned color grade with warm skin highlights.
coreVisualRelationships: The curve of the cowboy hat brim framing the upper third of the face
The contrast between the white textured henley and the dark blue industrial background
The vertical alignment of the large-scale typography with the subject's torso
The interplay of warm tan tones in the hat and skin against the cool blue shadows
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting emphasizing skin texture and facial hair
A weathered, slightly distressed finish on the background and clothing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered-right, filling the frame from the chest up; the head is slightly tilted.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the sharp brim of the cowboy hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, follows the brim down to the facial hair, then drops to the large text block on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is a textured wall that provides a dark canvas for the light-colored clothing and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep desaturated blue (background and text shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white shirt and blue wall; skin tones are mid-saturation with high-clarity texture.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical stretching of all glyphs to emphasize height over width
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic style pairing using two different weights and colors of the same condensed sans-serif family.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary vertical weight and condensed structure.
Clean, condensed uppercase aesthetic suitable for modern country branding.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-detail portrait of a man with a goatee wearing a distressed tan cowboy hat and a white button-up henley shirt. He is leaning against a dark blue, weathered metal wall with visible bolts. The lighting should be dramatic with cool shadows and warm highlights on the face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, extra-condensed sans-serif text in the bottom left corner. The primary text should be dark blue and stacked. Above it, add smaller condensed text in a tan color, right-aligned to the edge of the primary text block.

verificationChecks: Is the hat texture visible and weathered?
Is the text vertically condensed and stacked?
Does the color palette balance cool blues with warm tans?
Is the subject's gaze directed slightly off-camera?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color grade
Amount of distress on the cowboy hat
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the subject's face.
Check that the blue text is legible against the white shirt.
Verify the 'weathered' look is consistent across the hat and background.
Confirm the typography feels 'heavy' and grounded in the composition.
recipe.reuseFormula: Rugged Portrait + Industrial Background + Extra-Condensed Stacked Typography + Blue/Tan Color Grade
